def add_noise(img_orig):
    """
    Add salt-and-pepper noise to a grayscale image.
    Salt pixels are set to 255 (white), Pepper pixels are set to 0 (black).
    """
    # Create a copy to avoid modifying the original image passed to the function
    img = np.copy(img_orig)

    # Get image dimensions
    row, col = img.shape[0], img.shape[1]


    # Add salt noise (white pixels)
    # Random number of white pixels
    number_of_salt = random.randint(300, 10000)
    for i in range(number_of_salt):
        y_coord = random.randint(0, row - 1)
        x_coord = random.randint(0, col - 1)
        img[y_coord][x_coord] = 255


    # Add pepper noise (black pixels)
    # Random number of black pixels
    number_of_pepper = random.randint(300, 10000)
    for i in range(number_of_pepper):
        # Random row index
        y_coord = random.randint(0, row - 1)
        # Random column index
        x_coord = random.randint(0, col - 1)
        img[y_coord][x_coord] = 0

    return img

# Ensure img is the original, clean image before adding noise
# Reload the original image to ensure it's not already noisy from previous runs
img_clean = data.camera()

noisy_image = add_noise(img_clean)

# Display the noisy image
plt.imshow(noisy_image, cmap="gray", vmin=0, vmax=255)
plt.title("Noisy Image")
plt.show()

def remove_salt_and_pepper_noise_auto(img, window_size=3, k=3):
    img = util.img_as_ubyte(img)
    pad = window_size // 2
    padded_img = np.pad(img, pad, mode='reflect')
    denoised = img.copy()

    # Sliding window view
    windows = view_as_windows(padded_img, (window_size, window_size))

    for i in range(img.shape[0]):
        for j in range(img.shape[1]):
            local_window = windows[i, j]
            local_median = np.median(local_window)
            mad = np.median(np.abs(local_window - local_median))
            D = k * mad  # automatic threshold

            if np.abs(img[i, j] - local_median) > D:
                denoised[i, j] = local_median

    return denoised


# Load the camera image
img_clean = data.camera()

# Add salt-and-pepper noise using  add_noise ()
noisy_image = add_noise(img_clean)

# removing noise
processed_image_auto = remove_salt_and_pepper_noise_auto(noisy_image)

# Display
plt.figure(figsize=(18,6))
plt.subplot(1,3,1)
plt.title("Original Image")
plt.imshow(img_clean, cmap='gray', vmin=0, vmax=255)
plt.subplot(1,3,2)
plt.title("Noisy Image")
plt.imshow(noisy_image, cmap='gray', vmin=0, vmax=255)
plt.subplot(1,3,3)
plt.title("Automatic Threshold")
plt.imshow(processed_image_auto, cmap='gray', vmin=0, vmax=255)
plt.show()
